parsed.summary: The PR adds local link checking to the linkcheck builder, but it may not handle all edge cases and could introduce regressions.

issues.description: The PR does not handle cases where local links are relative paths or use different file extensions.
The PR may break existing behavior for projects that rely on the current implementation of the linkcheck builder.
The code could be more readable by adding comments and breaking down complex logic into smaller functions.
